sweeps.clubs: all four leagues reviewed via their comprehensive transfer lists (Wikipedia + targeted searches), then verified against actual data. KEY: the daily ESPN roster sync already drops every departed player cleanly (Griezmann, Bernardo Silva, Hojlund, Adeyemi all confirmed ABSENT from current data), so departures need no manual null. The residual risk is only WITHIN-LEAGUE attacker moves to clubs whose roster is INCOMPLETE (Ligue1: Lens/Lille/Monaco/Nice/Paris FC; LaLiga: Ath Bilbao/Celta/La Coruna/Racing Santander), where the sync cannot auto-reassign -- those need an override here.
sweeps.method: per-league transfer lists -> filter to attackers with real Understat history -> check current attribution in fetch_player_logs -> action only genuine within-league moves the roster sync could not fix. Cross-league arrivals (e.g. Gordon Newcastle->Barcelona, Adeyemi Dortmund->Barcelona) have no history in the destination league's feed and are invisible to props by design -- not overrides.
